_notes: Vulgate Ps 30:13-14 = 思高 Ps 31:13-14 (Vulgate Ps 10-112 +1 offset). The 思高 verse division differs slightly from the Vulgate: 思高 v.13 covers 'broken vessel / forgotten like the dead' and 思高 v.14 covers 'hearing the threats / conspiring to take my life'. The Vulgate's two-verse structure splits the 思高 v.14 content between the second half of Vg 30:13 and the whole of Vg 30:14, so the 思高 text of v.14 is distributed across both Latin strings at their respective * mediants.
